name: InPlayerEpisodePreview
overview: TV-friendly in-player episode browsing with continuous remote navigation.
description: Independent TV edition by jampez77, inspired by and based on Namo2/InPlayerEpisodePreview. Browse episodes across seasons using your remote, with titles, descriptions, and thumbnails. Desktop and mobile retain the original player button.

versions.changelog:
## Changelog
- Episodes and films now use the same local Jellyfin player action as live channels, preserving resume positions. The previous release changed only channel playback, leaving episode/film selections on the session-command path that could close after acknowledgement without playing.
- All TV selections now wait for the authenticated client playback report. An early player metadata change alone cannot dismiss the preview; failed or ignored actions retain the selection and offer a retry after 20 seconds.
- Cinema Mode is supported: a newly started intro confirms playback only when its exact queue position leads to the selected feature. Unchanged intros and unrelated queued features do not count.
- Version the injected script URL and disable caching of client scripts and playback reports to prevent stale update code or confirmation data.
- Verified the local playback contract against official Jellyfin Web v12.0. Validation: 26 unit tests, 75 browser tests, and server builds for 10.10.7, 10.11.x, and 12.x pass. Physical LG playback still needs a retest.
- Jellyfin 12 users should install version 2.5.4.3, restart Jellyfin, and fully close and reopen the LG app. README and demo updated.

## Changelog
- Watch channel now uses Jellyfin's local channel-card playback action when available, avoiding a server-to-TV command round trip that can silently fail on webOS clients. The authenticated session endpoint remains a fallback for clients without that action.
- Keep Tuning channel visible until Jellyfin reports the selected channel. Accepted commands and stalled requests that never start playback offer a retry after 20 seconds.
- Cover LG OK keycode 13, Jellyfin select commands, pointer clicks, delayed tuning, ignored commands, hung requests, and cancellation. Updated the README and demo scenarios.
- Validation: 26 unit tests, 64 browser tests, and builds for Jellyfin 10.10.7, 10.11.x, and 12.x pass. Physical LG channel tuning still needs confirmation.
- After updating, restart Jellyfin and fully close and reopen the LG app to load the new script.

## Changelog
- Fix the TV preview rendering below the screen on webOS 6 / Chromium 79: use explicit screen-edge positions instead of unsupported CSS inset.
- Preserve 16:9 thumbnails and control spacing without CSS aspect-ratio or flex gap; add compatible button and text-wrapping fallbacks.
- Add a regression test that simulates webOS 6 CSS limitations and numeric Down/Left/Right/Up remote events. The old bundle fails the on-screen positioning check; this release passes.
- Update the README and public demo. Verified with 26 unit tests, 54 browser tests, and builds for all three supported Jellyfin server targets.

After updating, restart Jellyfin and fully close and reopen the LG Jellyfin app. Physical TV verification remains outstanding.

## Changelog
- During pre-rolls and trailers, preview the upcoming film or episode from the current device's Jellyfin playback queue, marked Up next.
- Keep the TV panel hidden when upcoming details are unavailable, including playback-only intros and trailers without a queued feature.
- Release preview focus, overlay state, pending requests, and held remote keys as the player exits so shared Back and Home controls can respond immediately.
- Handle missing OSD IDs, equivalent GUID formats, and late playback reports without showing stale previews.
- Update the README and public demo with pre-roll examples. Verified by 26 unit tests, 53 browser tests, and builds for Jellyfin 10.10.7, 10.11.x, and 12.x.

The exact reported Back/Home position shift remains unconfirmed on the affected client; this release fixes the reproduced focus and key interception issues.
